Getting here

12326 Spotswood Furnace Road

Fredericksburg, Virginia 22407
From I-95 take exit 130B and go west on Route 3 for just over four miles. After the Harrison Crossing Shopping Center, turn right at the next light onto Spotswood Furnace Road. Riverbend High School is on the right; the church is on the left, just past the school.

Parking — free lot on site, entered directly from Spotswood Furnace Road. Additional overflow parking on the grass at feast days and the festival.
Accessibility — step-free entrance on the north side; the hall is reachable by lift.
Which door — the main narthex doors face the parking lot. They are open from 8:30 a.m.
